title: Small gauge and display visibility
summary: Feedback in this topic mainly concerns small or hard-to-see display elements, especially the fuel gauge, with a few unrelated mentions of sunlight and tiny touch targets.

positive.summary: One positive review notes the petrol gauge as a useful feature despite also describing it as tiny and nearly hidden on the display.

negative.summary: Negative reviews focus on the fuel gauge being too small or poorly placed, the display text and elements being tiny, and touch-screen targets being too small to use comfortably.

undetermined.summary: Undetermined reviews mention unrelated issues including abrupt power delivery in a narrow input range, tiny speckles seen in sunlight on the windscreen, and sunlight needing more reduction, so the topic is not coherent in these examples.

limitations: The undetermined examples mix unrelated subjects, including power delivery, windscreen speckles in sunlight, and sunlight reduction, so they do not support a single clear theme.
This topic sample is small and sentiment-stratified, so it should not be treated as representative of all owner experiences.
There are no mixed or neutral examples, and only one positive example, which limits comparison across sentiment groups.
